title: Event-driven vulnerability management with Amazon Inspector
description: Listens and routes Amazon Inspector events to EventBridge targets.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: Rules are created to listen to Amazon Inspector events. When the vulnerability matches custom logic teams are notified using SNS and information is saved in DynamoDB using Lambda.

bullets.text: Amazon Inspector now scans AWS Lambda functions for vulnerabilities
Perform continuous vulnerability scanning of AWS Lambda functions with Amazon Inspector
